indications.name: Parkinson’s disease (PD) in adults
indications.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-11-20: Confirmed by the ORIG-1 approval letter; the original label (ORIG-1) lists it.

evidence.quote: This NDA provides for the use of Juvmo (tavapadon) tablets 0.25 mg, 1 mg, 5 mg, 10 mg, and 15 mg for the treatment of Parkinson's disease in adults.

pivotal.checkedBy: Overnight agent 2026-10-31: Confirmed by label section 14 and the registry record.

evidence.quote: in adults not on concomitant levodopa was established in two 27-week randomized, multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled studies, Study 1 (NCT04201093) and Study 2 (NCT04223193).
